title: Missed Detections and False Alarms in a CNN Technosignature Detector on Breakthrough Listen Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.22050v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Radio technosignature searches rely on machine learning detectors to shrink the candidate pool before a human looks at it. They are validated on held-out data from the training distribution, which excludes the cases where they are most likely to fail: a technosignature has unknown morphology, and terrestrial interference is unbounded in variety. I trained a standard competition detector once, froze it, and probed it with 15,000 injections across ten morphologies and five amplitudes, placed into real Green Bank backgrounds. Two directions were tested: genuine signals with morphologies other than a straight narrowband line, and interference resembling the training data. Recall did not follow the predicted ordering, and it fell as signals brightened, even for a needle of the kind the detector was trained on (from 0.590 to 0.090). One interference morphology reached a false positive rate of 0.627, comparable to the detector's own baseline

translated_title: CNN技术签名探测器在“突破聆听”数据中的漏检与误报
translated_abstract: 射电技术签名（technosignature）搜索依赖于机器学习探测器在人工审查之前缩小候选池。这些探测器通常在来自训练分布的留出数据上进行验证，而这种验证方式恰恰排除了它们最可能失败的情形：技术签名具有未知的形态，而地面干扰的种类则无穷无尽。本文作者训练了一个标准的竞赛型探测器一次后将其冻结，然后用15,000次信号注入对其进行探测，涵盖十种形态和五种振幅，并将这些信号置于真实的绿岸天文台背景数据中。测试了两个方向：形态不同于直线窄带信号的真实信号，以及与训练数据相似的干扰。结果显示，召回率没有遵循预期的排序，且随着信号变亮反而下降，即使是探测器被训练寻找的那类“大海捞针”式信号也是如此（召回率从0.590降至0.090）。其中一种干扰形态达到了0.627的假阳性率，与探测器自身的基线相当。
tldr: 该研究通过向真实绿岸天文台数据中注入15,000个不同形态和振幅的信号，对一个冻结的CNN技术签名探测器进行压力测试，发现其召回率随信号增强反而下降，且某些干扰形态的假阳性率高达0.627，揭示了现有机器学习探测器在训练分布之外的脆弱性。
en_tdlr: This study stress-tests a frozen CNN technosignature detector with 15,000 injected signals of varied morphologies and amplitudes in real Green Bank backgrounds, revealing that recall paradoxically decreases as signals brighten and certain interference morphologies achieve false positive rates as high as 0.627, exposing the fragility of machine learning detectors beyond their training distribution.
